verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-assistant product, so the axis applies. No evidence item mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking controls. The pack covers the API, webhooks, SDKs, MCP, and pricing features, none of which address this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
